Riggie is very attached to his Daddy and almost always presses the Daddy button in the evenings when he is traveling. I don’t know if it’s because he misses him or he is anticipating him coming home because he usually comes home at night (likely both).  He surprised me when he used one of his new buttons - Come - to say “Daddy Come Riggie”. While this is a new button for him, it certainly is not a new word, as that has been his recall word from day 1.  I find it interesting that he didn’t use the 3 word combo until after I told him that Daddy was on his way home.
